name: OmaProw
author: marcuspelo
description: Search Prowlarr indexers and grab releases (individually or in bulk), with sortable results and history.

barWidget.description: Search Prowlarr, filter by category, sort results, grab releases individually or in bulk, and browse history.

schema.label: Prowlarr base URL
schema.description: Fallback base URL if URL_BASE is not set in ~/.config/omaprow/.env (no trailing slash)

schema.label: Results limit
schema.description: Maximum number of releases requested per search

schema.label: Default category ID
schema.description: Category pre-selected on open (0 = All, 1000 = Consoles, 2000 = Movies, 3000 = Audio, 4000 = PC, 5000 = TV, 7000 = Books)
